runtime_scope_note: The formal grid retains the single-query, moderate-reuse and high-reuse regimes while removing two redundant intermediate batches before formal timing. This runtime reduction was frozen after mechanism smoke and before formal measurements.

stop_rule: If admission fails, retain the negative result and permanently stop adding optimizer query families or tuning this family.
